subject: interpreting TVECM, 2 regimes only ECT common to both regimes

messages.author: f64ffd84cb3a7faf
messages.subject: interpreting TVECM, 2 regimes only ECT common to both regimes
parts:
Hi everybody,
I am a PhD candidate an I am using the package from not so long and I have maybe a basic question. I do not know how to interpret the results from a TVECM model specification where I establish only ECT as common to both regimes.
Is ECT- the first regime ECT, and ECT+ the correction term of the second?
My command and results are below.
Many thanks
Beatriz 

tprices1<-TVECM(prices1, nthresh=1,common=c("only_ECT"))
133 (5.3%) points of the grid lead to regimes with percentage of observations < trim and were not computed

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] interpreting TVECM, 2 regimes only ECT common to both regimes
parts:
Hi Beatriz

The name of the parameter is admittedly a little bit confusing: what is common here are the lags, and what is regime specific is the speed of adjustment coefficient on the ECT. Hence "ECT-" stands for coefficient on deviations that are smaller then your threshold parameter, while ECT deviations above it.

Hope this helps, 

Matthieu
